note: Dashboard version record (10-observability.md: 'A dashboard is not release evidence unless its record identifies the measurement boundary, workload, duration, UTC clock source/offset, exact software versions, sample count, and whether failures or restarts are included.'). Queries are bound to the O2 canonical streams the OTel collector routes to: 'metrics' (OTLP + Flink Prometheus remote-write) and 'logs' (filelog via O2 header routing). Panels render empty until their data source exports; the EXECUTOR OTLP export lands via the telemetry.rs TelemetrySink seam.

dashboards.title: Safe to Trade
dashboards.measurement_boundary: global (operator): execution gate + order flow + data-feed health + system state
dashboards.utc_clock: host UTC; O2 _timestamp; offset panel bound to service clock_offset_ms
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — panel 2 (unresolved/unknown) and log tails explicitly capture failures
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64 (compose OPENOBSERVE_IMAGE); dashboard API v8

dashboards.title: Orders and Fills
dashboards.measurement_boundary: execution_partition: order lifecycle, broker confirmations (fills/cancels/rejects), gate state
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — reject/unknown panel and executor log tail

dashboards.title: Market Data Ingestion
dashboards.measurement_boundary: instrument: feed throughput, losslessness counters, reconnects, clock offset, subscription completeness
dashboards.workload: ingestion bridge + IngestionService (1,024-instrument / single-connection testing envelope)
dashboards.utc_clock: host UTC; O2 _timestamp; clock-offset panel bound to service clock_offset_ms
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — reconnect/epoch panel and ingestion log tail
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; go-bridge (Go SDK pin GO_ARROW_SDK_VERSION)

dashboards.title: Storage and EOD
dashboards.measurement_boundary: global: Fluss append/fetch latency, checkpoint health, EOD offload state
dashboards.failures_or_restarts_included: yes — checkpoint-failure panel and Fluss log tail
dashboards.software_versions: OpenObserve v0.91.5-amd64; Fluss client pinned in ingestion Cargo/pom
